name: keyboard-path-checker
description: Run declared keyboard journeys against a declared capture of a local fixture's controls -- reachability, activation, dismissal and focus return -- and report what the capture could not tell it rather than passing on silence.

scripts.lint: for file in bin/*.mjs src/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run example && npm run example:failing && npm run example:incomplete && npm run pack:check
